name: OMNIYAT
verdict: Flagship of OMNIYAT GROUP, a private Dubai ultra-luxury developer founded and chaired by Mahdi Amjad. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: private company; no state ownership found, no human-rights finding found. Dubai ultra-luxury real-estate developer; added as a Bahrain Victorious partner for 2026 (announced Nov 2025), featured on the sleeves and side of the 2026 jersey.
